## deploy/release-notes-8.19.0-ff7b.md
1 # Release notes: quotes-api build 8.19.0-ff7b
2 
3 Previous build: 8.18.6. Defaults below override repository config files.
4 
5 - deps: http client library upgraded to a patch release
6 - scheduler: cron jitter added to cleanup job
7 - security: TLS session tickets rotated hourly
8 - metrics: db pool gauges renamed to `db_pool_*`
9 - clients: default `clients.risk-score.timeout_ms` lowered from 2500 to 800 (fail fast)
10 - cache: default `cache.ttl_s` unchanged (120)
11 - build: container base image refreshed
12 - tracing: sampling rate default 1% (unchanged)
13 - config: `log.level` default remains info
14 - metrics: new histogram for cache hit latency
15 - db: default connection pool `db.pool.max_size` lowered from 60 to 14 to fit the shared-db connection quota
16 - feature flags: `ff-legacy-export` removed (was 0%)
17 - locale: currency formatting fixes
18 - api: `/v1/status` returns build id
19 - logging: structured request ids added to access logs
20 - health: readiness probe timeout 2s (unchanged)
## ops/oncall-notes.md
1 # On-call notes - quotes-api incident 2031-05-22
2 
3 Informal running notes. Not reviewed; may be out of date.
4 
5 - 08:36 api-gateway 5xx for quotes-api since build 8.19.0-ff7b rolled out. Many risk-score timeouts.
6 - 08:46 Suspect the risk-score timeout default change in 8.19.0-ff7b; asking for a mitigation.
